_doc: Machine-readable mirror of references/conventions.md. The contract hub for the Office Trust Layer plugin. Components read these values; they never redefine them.
source_id_scheme: S<n> (S1, S2, ...) assigned in the source packet; stable and never reused for the life of the artifact
loop_stop_condition: each round runs verify-prior AND fresh-full passes; stop only when no open/fixed-claimed/still-open finding AND no new must-fix this round; round-cap with anything unresolved => survivors still-open => not-ready

supporting.rationale: why this source backs the claim

_rules.confidence: 0.0-1.0 link confidence (source supports claim); sub-threshold links held for human approval, never auto-asserted

speaker_note_template.Needs review: what a human must confirm, or 'none'

command_io.manifest: manifest.json in out_dir; for model-run loops records input/source-packet/reviewer-prompt hashes, model+version, timestamp per round (full policy in sensitivity-routing-policy.md, S02)

status_notes.ok: ran fully; nothing beyond the normal verdict
status_notes.ok-with-warnings: ran fully with caveats (e.g. capability fell back: 'recalc unverified')
status_notes.blocked: precondition unmet / gated (e.g. sensitivity+routing not recorded before a model-run loop); work is well-defined but gated
status_notes.failed: attempted and errored (tool crash, unreadable file)

waiver_rule: any waived must-fix caps the verdict at ready-with-limitations (never plain ready); a waiver requires named owner + required decision + due date + signoff status + written rationale persisted in the manifest; a Board/Regulatory waived must-fix additionally requires named-owner signoff recorded before the verdict may be returned (else not-ready)

release_thresholds.soft_criterion_removed: ship-if-green-or-gaps-listed is NOT a release criterion; the four numbers above are hard gates at hr-00 (M1) and hr-04 (M2)

threshold_change_rule: thresholds may change ONLY via a logged rationale recorded BEFORE the release benchmark runs; never relaxed after seeing failures; a post-hoc change blocks release
_v2_additive: Everything below is a v2 additive extension (document surface + source verification), mirroring conventions.md §1.6-§1.7 and §2.2-§2.5. The v1 keys above (source_status, severity, review_status, readiness, issue_lifecycle, provenance_record, command_io, waiver_rule, release_thresholds, threshold_change_rule) are FROZEN and unchanged.
doc_format_required: every doc-surface record (map/locator/claim/evidence/review/benchmark/dogfood) MUST carry a format; reported per-format AND combined; a single 'doc' verdict never hides a per-format extraction/mutation limit (review finding #6)

verification._doc: v2 verify-against-the-world layer (conventions.md §2.2-§2.5). A verification result becomes a new S<n> source and joins the §2 provenance record; provider is metadata only and never part of the schema.
verification.provider: metadata only, e.g. exa / a knowledge MCP / obsidian / local-vault — never part of source_type; bound at runtime by the adapter registry (F2-04)
verification.result_becomes_source: a corroborates/contradicts source is admitted as a new S<n> (URL or note-path locator) with its own source_status + sensitivity and enters supporting[]/conflict normally
verification.contradiction_rule: contradicts => review_status conflicting + a §2 conflict object; never averaged, blended, or silently overwritten

per_travel_class_caps.travels: bounded cap over the top material claims
per_travel_class_caps.board-regulatory: higher cap; headline + executive-summary set always in scope
per_travel_class_caps._rule: the contract fixes the ordering + the existence of a cap, NOT the number; N/timeout/dedupe are tuneable per run and recorded in the manifest; eligible-but-skipped => not-checked-budget, never silently dropped

external_source_quality.high_confidence: >=2 independent sources OR 1 primary/official; a lone secondary is needs-review, not verified

verification.egress_rule: confidential/restricted claim text is never egressed; only a sanitised/abstracted query may leave (named-entity masking, magnitude coarsening, source-label removal) with a raw-vs-egressed manifest diff; restricted Board/Regulatory => skipped-egress (recorded not-checked-budget) unless a named-owner waiver permits a sanitised query; internal-vault/internal-memory verification has no egress and still runs; mechanism lives in sensitivity-routing-policy.md

doc_pretty_but_wrong._doc: doc-surface defect taxonomy (conventions.md §1.7); severities use the §1.2 enum verbatim; the 'both'-surface v1 PRETTY_BUT_WRONG items also apply to doc; machine-readable doc rows are added to skills/trust-review/scripts/review_contract.py PRETTY_BUT_WRONG when the doc reviewer is built (contract precedes implementation); the canonical v1 list is unchanged

_v3_additive: Everything below is a v3 additive extension (recurring-update primitive on a stable claim identity + degraded-status caps + backward-compat). It mirrors conventions.md §7. The v1 keys (source_status..threshold_change_rule) AND the v2 keys (surface..doc_pretty_but_wrong) above are FROZEN and unchanged; the §5 release_thresholds + threshold_change_rule are NOT touched. A v3 cap can only make a verdict worse, never better — it is never a relaxation. Findings refer to office-trust-layer-v3-review-disposition.md.

degraded_status_caps._doc: conventions.md §7.1 (findings 3/4/5). A named condition that CAPS readiness — never yields plain 'ready'. Recorded in manifest.degraded_status[] = {cap, condition, capped_at, surface, note}; absent => [] => v1/v2 behaviour. Strictest cap governs; orthogonal to and stacks with the §4 waiver (a cap can only lower, never raise).

cap_to_readiness.sidecar-only-pdf: ready-with-limitations; not-ready-for-forwarding for the survives-the-forward property (evidence does not travel inside the file)
cap_to_readiness.recalc-unverified: ready-with-limitations; the checks-tab readiness CLAIM is blocked (smoke alarm unpowered, ab-01)
cap_to_readiness.same-family-reviewer: by travel class (§7.2): internal/travels => ready-with-limitations; board-regulatory => blocked unless named-owner signoff => then ready-with-limitations

degraded_status_caps.rule: a cap NEVER produces plain 'ready'; multiple caps => strictest governs; never a relaxation of §5

reviewer_independence_by_travel_class._doc: conventions.md §7.2 (finding 5). Independence is a value gated by travel class (order internal<travels<board-regulatory). Recorded in manifest.routing.reviewer_independence.

by_travel_class.internal: same-family accepted (record same-family-reviewer cap note; not gated beyond it)
by_travel_class.travels: same-family accepted (record same-family-reviewer cap note; not gated beyond it)
by_travel_class.board-regulatory: requires cross-vendor OR named-human-SME; a same-family/same-model fallback => blocked, or ready-with-limitations ONLY after a named-owner signoff (the §4 waiver shape) recorded in the manifest

checks_tab_spec._doc: conventions.md §7.3 (finding 4 / ab-01). Controlled enum of workbook checks-tab categories (the smoke alarm). The checks-tab readiness CLAIM is valid only when a live recalc was verified; recalc-unverified => the recalc-unverified cap applies and the claim is blocked (static formula assertions are a fallback, NOT equivalent to recalc).

embedded_evidence._doc: conventions.md §7.4 (finding 3 / ab-02). In-PDF embedded-evidence channel so a forwarded PDF carries its own proof; extends the v2 per-format evidence channels and the §1.6 doc locator grammar (additive — §1.6 text unchanged).

channels.embedded-pdf: doc/pdf — evidence embedded as PDF annotations/attachments; preserves author pages, does not break signatures/forms/tagged-PDF; travels inside the file
channels.sidecar: any — evidence in .trust/<run_id>/ only; triggers the sidecar-only-pdf cap (§7.1)

embedded_evidence.degradation: embedded-pdf unavailable => degrade to sidecar + record the sidecar-only-pdf cap; NEVER a silent survives-the-forward claim

claim_identity._doc: conventions.md §7.5 (finding 2). Canonical per-claim identity computed by references/scripts/claim_identity.py (pure stdlib); consumed by office-update (S02/S03) + verification. Lets a refresh distinguish 'same claim, moved' from 'meaning changed'.
claim_identity.claim_id: C-<first12 hex of sha256(normalized_text_hash + ':' + source_fingerprint)>; stable for the life of the claim; persists across moves; locator excluded so a move does not change identity
claim_identity.normalized_text_hash: sha256 of text after normalization: lowercase, NFKC, collapse whitespace, strip surrounding punctuation, normalize number formatting WITHOUT changing magnitudes/units
claim_identity.locator_hash: sha256 of the canonical locator string; surface+format specific (tab!cell / slide N/shape / §1.6 doc grammar incl. §7.4 anchors)
claim_identity.source_fingerprint: sha256 over sorted backing-source tuples (source_id, source_status, content_or_excerpt_hash, as_of_date)
claim_identity.moved_claim_diff: same normalized_text_hash AND same source_fingerprint AND different locator_hash => 'moved', identity STABLE (claim_id carried, locator/retrieval updated, a prior verdict MAY carry); same on text+source+locator => 'unchanged'; any change to normalized_text_hash or source_fingerprint => a NEW identity (new claim_id) that starts needs-review and CANNOT inherit a prior verdict
claim_identity.invalidation_rule: ANY invalidation class forces re-review (the carried verified/ready does not transfer); a 'moved' claim with NONE of them is the only case that carries a verdict

human_gate_digest_invariants._doc: conventions.md §7.6 (finding 7 / av-01). Non-negotiable invariants so a prioritised digest never hides an unresolved must-fix. A digest that cannot satisfy all four returns not-ready (the safe default).

vault_writeback_record._doc: conventions.md §7.7 (finding 8 / av-02). Two-phase write-back so a derived note never poisons the corpus: quarantine -> promoted ONLY after explicit human approval. Until promoted, the verifier treats it as audit metadata, not a primary fact.
vault_writeback_record.rules: quarantine->promoted requires a named human approval (approved_by+approved_at); source_authority is always derived-provenance (never masquerades as primary); supersedes/dedupe_key prevent stale/duplicate entries; rollback_pointer+run_hash make every promotion reversible

schema_version._doc: conventions.md §7.8 (finding 10 / fd-03). The .trust/<run_id>/ run-schema lineage, additive at each step. Distinct from the contract-doc 'version' above. Backward-compat proven by eval/compat_harness.py.

lineage.1: base manifest: artifact, travel_class, sensitivity, routing, rounds, gate
lineage.2: adds verification, egress, adapter_bindings, retention (document + source-verification surfaces)
lineage.3: adds degraded_status (§7.1), reviewer_independence (§7.2), human-gate-digest invariants (§7.6), two-phase vault-writeback (§7.7), claim-identity stamps (§7.5)

schema_version.backward_compat_rule: a v3 reader MUST load every committed v1/v2 run; new v3 optional fields default safely (absent => v1/v2 behaviour, never a crash); a v3 refresh consuming a prior run is READ-ONLY (never mutates prior artifacts) and stamps schema_version + migration_notes onto its OWN new output only

v3_operations._doc: conventions.md §7 — new operations registered in capability-inventory.md + references/scripts/adapter_registry.py. DEFERRED-FUNCTIONAL until the session that first depends on each proves it live (vault_write: av-02/S09; external_reviewer: pt-02/S08), per the 'fixtures ship per feature session' rule.
v3_operations.vault_write: two-phase quarantine->promoted write-back (§7.7); candidate providers a provider-pack capture/write -> Obsidian write/create -> local-vault file write -> .trust quarantine sidecar (builtin terminal); absent => the derived note stays in .trust quarantine and is NEVER auto-promoted (the av-02 safety property)
v3_operations.external_reviewer: an independent cross-vendor reviewer (§7.2); candidate providers a cross-vendor model via Agent -> same-family Agent model-split (capped) -> named-human-SME signoff (builtin terminal); same-family terminal triggers the same-family-reviewer cap; Board/Regulatory needs cross-vendor or named-human-SME (else blocked)
